content.short: Utopia helps crypto-native orgs manage payroll, invoices, accounting, budgeting, and payments through multi-sig wallets.
content.description: Utopia is a modern, integrated system for payroll, invoicing, accounting, and budgeting designed for crypto-native organizations. It helps teams manage and send payments through multi-signature wallets, simplifying and securing financial workflows. Built on Gnosis SAFE, the platform provides a robust, secure base for crypto-native teams to handle payroll, track expenses, and govern budgeting with clarity and confidence. It is suitable for crypto-native teams across startups, DAOs, and distributed organizations.
content.meta: A modern system for payroll, invoices, accounting, and budgeting for crypto-native orgs. Discover Utopia and other Web3 Wallet Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
